# Meaningful Sound

> Meaningful Sound is an independent studio building native iOS, iPadOS, and macOS apps for working musicians.

## Apps

- [PedalEditor](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/): A wireless editor for MIDI guitar pedals. From an iPhone, iPad or Mac it recalls presets and edits parameters over Bluetooth LE MIDI or Wi-Fi (RTP-MIDI), using Program Change and Control Change; USB is supported too. It works with pedals from any brand, including the ones the manufacturer never made an editor for. Every supported pedal has a profile built from the manufacturer's manual: 80 in the app today, from Strymon (21), UAFX (14), Walrus Audio (10), Meris (8), Chase Bliss (5), Jackson Audio (5), Hologram (3), Boss (2), Empress Effects (2), Source Audio (2), Line 6 ([DL4 MkII](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/line-6/dl4-mkii/)), Alexander Pedals ([Radical Delay DX](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/alexander/radical-delay-dx/)), DigiTech ([Whammy](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/digitech/whammy/)), Electro-Harmonix ([POG3](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/ehx/pog3/)), GFI System ([Specular Tempus](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/gfi/specular-tempus/)), Keeley Electronics ([Nocturne](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/keeley/nocturne/)), Old Blood Noise ([Dark Star Stereo](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/old-blood-noise/dark-star-stereo/)) and Red Panda ([Particle V2](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/red-panda/particle-v2/)). A further 161 profiles are already built and releasing on a rolling basis — every one is checked against the manufacturer's published MIDI implementation before it ships. The complete list of both is published. Presets live in one cross-brand library and follow songs, song sections and setlists. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pedaleditor/id6761016084).
- [Fretboard Origin](https://meaningfulsound.net/FretboardOrigin/): A fretboard companion for every stringed instrument you play — 34 instruments (guitar, bass, mandolin, banjo, ukulele, oud, sitar, koto, charango, and more), thousands of chord voicings across 43 qualities, 14 scale types in every key, 13 arpeggio types, built-in YIN strobe tuner, and a tanpura drone for practice. Native iPhone, iPad. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fretboard-origin/id6764200037).
- [SongForm](https://meaningfulsound.net/SongForm/): A songwriter's workspace for sections, lyrics, layers, and co-writes. Multi-take recording, key/scale theory, fragment-based collaboration, portable `.songform` document. Native iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Coming soon.

## Key Facts

- **Developer:** Meaningful Sound (independent studio)
- **Platforms:** iOS, iPadOS, macOS — all native, no Electron, no web wrappers
- **Privacy posture:** No accounts. No advertising. No cross-app tracking. Anonymous product analytics (via TelemetryDeck) — not linked to any user identity, no personal data collected. iCloud sync uses the user's personal account; Meaningful Sound has no access to user content.
- **Distribution:** Apple App Store only
- **Contact:** Instagram [@pedaleditor](https://instagram.com/pedaleditor), TikTok [@pedaleditor](https://tiktok.com/@pedaleditor), YouTube [@meaningfulsound](https://youtube.com/@meaningfulsound)
